name: Uelsen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, green and white with a narrow green middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Uelsen (an oak twig between crowned serpents on white).
history: Municipal flag of Uelsen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Uelsen arms — oak twig and serpents on white
